items.title: Pay outstanding balance from annual statement
items.quote: Please pay the balance within 14 days of the statement date.
items.computation: Statement date is 20 November 2026. Under §187(1) BGB, when a period runs 'from' an event, the day of the event itself is not counted, so the 14-day period starts on 21 November 2026 (day 1) and the 14th day is 4 December 2026. 4 December 2026 is a Friday, not a Sunday/public holiday in NRW, so no extension under §193 BGB applies.

items.title: New monthly instalment amount takes effect
items.quote: Your new monthly instalment from December is €94.00.
items.computation: The letter states the new instalment of €94.00 applies 'from December' but does not give the exact day in December on which the first instalment at the new amount is due (e.g. 1st of month vs. a specific instalment date on the contract). Without the contract's fixed instalment day, the precise due date cannot be determined.
